run_structured_outputs_choice: run structured outputs with choice constraint to classify sentiment as Positive or Negative
run_structured_outputs_regex: run structured outputs with regex constraint to generate formatted email addresses
run_structured_outputs_json: run structured outputs with json schema constraint using a Pydantic model to generate structured car descriptions
run_structured_outputs_grammar: run structured outputs with grammar constraint to generate SQL queries from natural language prompts
run_structured_outputs_main: run the main structured outputs demo with all four constraint types on a vLLM model
